## Design decisions (hand-written, from DESIGN.md)

- **The pace is "slow"**: no combat, no failure; the player progresses by taking photos and wandering. For any new mechanic, first ask "will it make people feel rushed?"; if so, leave it out.
- **Film is the only limited resource**: each photo uses one (photo:taken in main.js); the only sources are the start, the old fisherman's dialogue, and quest rewards. Be careful when adding new ways to get it, so film never becomes unlimited.
- **Terrain is procedural, so coordinates cannot be hard-coded**: the cabin position (home) and the riverside (river) are computed at startup; everything in content/ is placed relative to them with `{ place: 'home', x, z }`.

## Quests (content/quests.js)

- **first-light** 第一缕光 (starts on world:ready), reward: give film×12
  1. 和老渔夫聊聊（靠近按 E） ⟶ flag metFisher (target: NPC fisher)
  2. 收集 3 个野莓 ⟶ has berry×3
  3. 在 17:00–19:00 之间拍一张照片（按 P） ⟶ counter sunsetPhotos≥1

## Trigger zones, level markers, places

- Place home: cabin (a flat spot found on the terrain at startup; the cabin stands here)
- Place river: nearest riverside to the cabin (found at startup; the old fisherman goes here in the morning)

## Conditions/effects the game adds (content/rules.js)

- Condition **timeAfter** (clock): the day has passed this clock time

## Saves

- Save prefix saveKey: default
- Save slots: slot1
- Autosave: every 3 minutes
- Content-related saves handled by the engine: story flags and counters (engine.vars), inventory, quest progress, timers (clock, after registered by event name), pickups (world), felled trees (vegetation)
